name: @libertai/confidential-inference
description: Verify you are talking to LibertAI inference running in an attested confidential VM, then talk to it directly.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../wasm --release --target nodejs --out-dir ../js/vendor/node --out-name cic && rm -f vendor/node/.gitignore && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('vendor/node/package.json', '{\"type\": \"commonjs\"}\n')"
